name: Confront Lorthuna
objectiveText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.   Confront Lorthuna  ( 1 )

comments.body:
Today on the Beta, this quest seems bugged.

After you defeat Baron Anvillax, the Air Lord spawns 6 malevolent storms that stay neutral and do nothing until the event despawns.
replies: Ok after 3 tries, YOU HAVE TO LET THE BARON hit the NPCs to trigger the rest of the event, otherwise you'll get stuck in a loop
Jump into wind affect after peacekeeper - looks like quest is bugged but it's not.

comments.body: Well, if it [i]looks[/i] like there isn't an air bridge there, don't test it out, like I did, and fall to your death in a place so far off the map that your only option is rez sickness...
replies: OK, but when the air bridge does look like it's there, you can just run into it, regardless of what the nearby guard says.

comments.body: At the end of the event and the roleplay, one of the Kirin Tor mages opens a portal back to Valanaar. If you wait too long, it will despawn. You'll need to run back down and start the event again. This time, click the portal faster. I presume the same is true of the horde version of the quest.
